    SELECT member_fan_pivot, SUM(spend_usd) / NULLIF((SUM(memb_days)::numeric / 30.44), 0) as ffv
    FROM membershipandspending GROUP BY member_fan_pivot
),
fan_sls AS (
    SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot, 
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CAST(sf.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix' AS int) + 
            CAST(sf.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs' AS int) + 
            CAST(sf.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt' AS int)
        ), 0) as sls
    FROM supportandfeedback sf
    JOIN interactions i ON sf.support_interact_pivot = i.activity_reg
    GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot
),
all_fans AS (
    SELECT f.user_registry, f.nick_label,
        COALESCE(ffv.ffv, 0) as fan_financial_value,
        COALESCE(sls.sls, 0) as support_load_score
    FROM fans f
    LEFT JOIN fan_ffv ffv ON f.user_registry = ffv.member_fan_pivot
    LEFT JOIN fan_sls sls ON f.user_registry = sls.interact_fan_pivot
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT user_registry, nick_label, fan_financial_value, support_load_score,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fan_financial_value) as ffv_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY support_load_score) as sls_rank
    FROM all_fans
)
SELECT user_registry, nick_label, fan_financial_value, support_load_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN ffv_rank >= 0.5 AND sls_rank < 0.5 THEN 'Ideal Fans'
        WHEN ffv_rank >= 0.5 AND sls_rank >= 0.5 THEN 'At-Risk VIPs'
        WHEN ffv_rank < 0.5 AND sls_rank < 0.5 THEN 'Quiet Majority'
        ELSE 'Resource Drain'
    END as fan_segment
FROM ranked;
